responsibility: Implements the base symbol object behavior and the front end’s generic symbol table. This file provides default `Dsymbol` operations such as syntax-copy scaffolding, one-member reduction for wrappers and overload sets, pretty-printing, pointer/static-ctor queries, `$` variable synthesis for array operations, and the `DsymbolTable` insertion/lookup/update primitives, along with the concrete comparison logic for protection attributes (`Prot`).
same_name_distinction: Implements concrete base-symbol and symbol-table behavior, including default `Dsymbol` operations, one-member reduction, `$` helper synthesis, table insert/lookup/update, and `Prot` comparison logic, whereas `dsymbol.h` declares the central symbol classes, pass state, flags, and APIs.
